capabilities: Read notes aloud using a chosen text-to-speech provider
Play generated audio in an audiobook-style player with speed control
Save readings as MP3 files and embed them in notes
Apply per-language speech profiles for acronyms, abbreviations and pauses
disambiguation: Not voice input or dictation; it converts note text into spoken audio through an external text-to-speech provider.
extras: Every feature needs a third-party TTS provider and its key; in-depth instructions, troubleshooting and FAQ live in an external User Guide. The README states there is no account with the developer and no tracking.
problem: Notes are silent text, so you cannot listen to them while walking, commuting or resting your eyes, and there is no built-in way to turn them into reusable audio files.

relations.evidence: Use the text-to-speech provider you already have: OpenAI, ElevenLabs, AWS Polly, Google Cloud, Azure Speech, MiniMax

requires.name: Text-to-speech provider API key (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, AWS Polly, Google Cloud, Azure Speech or MiniMax)

summary: Text-to-speech player that reads notes aloud through a chosen TTS provider, with an audiobook-style player, bookmarks and MP3 saving.
